build_standard_geometry_from_IMAS: build standard geometry from an IMAS netCDF file using IMASConfig and build_geometry
build_single_slice_geometry_from_IMAS: build a single-slice geometry from an IMAS file with load_all_time_slices=False and a specific slice_index
test_single_slice_consistent_with_provid: test that single-slice geometry matches the all-slices geometry provider at a given time slice
test_gm4_gm5_terms: test that gm4 and gm5 metric terms are correctly computed across EQDSK, IMAS, and Chease geometry providers
build_geometry_provider_from_IMAS: build a geometry provider from IMAS that returns geometry at arbitrary time slices
